title: G4 v4E to v4F lineage audit

comparison_verdict.causal_statement: The v4E to v4F outcome is compound and cannot be attributed to steric reaction, dynamic contact search, or any other single change.

changes.name: two_way_steric_reaction
changes.parent: Collagen received steric penalty but the moving cell did not receive its reaction.
changes.child: The cell receives the equal-and-opposite sum of collagen steric forces.
changes.causal_boundary: The linear rigid-circle penalty and stiffness are provisional; this change was not isolated from the other changes.

changes.name: current_position_dynamic_contact_search
changes.parent: Relocation selected from a candidate set defined around the initial cell/network state.
changes.child: Failed/unavailable sites search the current deformed network around the current cell, with 5 s retry.
changes.causal_boundary: Geometric update was requested; the 5 s retry interval is a provisional implementation assumption.

changes.name: memoryless_e0_e1
changes.parent: Unguided relocation retained the old attachment tangent.
changes.child: E0/E1 relocation uses Gaussian distance weight only; front memory exists only in E2/E3.
changes.causal_boundary: This improves the within-v4F factor definition but changes the parent baseline.

changes.name: shared_probing_reach
changes.parent: E0/E1 had zero extra probing reach; E2/E3 had 5 um.
changes.child: All four conditions use contact width plus 5 um probing reach.
changes.causal_boundary: Control contact availability changes across the parent-child comparison.

changes.name: independent_counter_rng_mixing
changes.parent: Counter address used additive seed and item terms, producing a seed-item alias.
changes.child: Seed, step, channel and item use distinct 64-bit multiplicative/XOR mixing.
changes.causal_boundary: All stochastic rupture, binding, relocation and front histories can change.

changes.name: all_site_front_competition
changes.parent: Only site 0 could mature into the front.
changes.child: All sufficiently mature bound sites compete with alignment-weighted selection.
changes.causal_boundary: Removes an index/angular-order bias but changes the biological front-selection rule.

changes.name: matched_even_initial_contacts
changes.parent: Guided cases used weighted initial sites; controls used evenly distributed surface sites.
changes.child: All E0-E3 cases start from evenly distributed surface sites.
changes.causal_boundary: Within-v4F matching improves, but the v4E-v4F initial states are not identical.

changes.name: same_time_level_cell_ecm_update
changes.parent: Cell position advanced before the ECM update.
changes.child: ECM and cell increments are evaluated from the same t_n geometry; cell position advances afterward.
changes.causal_boundary: Removes operator splitting but changes the full deterministic trajectory.

changes.name: representative_seed_and_summary_change
changes.parent: Representative seed 45 selected as typical for E3.
changes.child: Representative seed 51 selected jointly across E0-E3; paired contrasts and new telemetry were added.
changes.causal_boundary: The two published animations are not a same-network visual comparison.
